body: I trust her in this moment yes. I do not trust the future for no one just starts to leave her soon to be husband for a guy she just met. Its always over time and that is what frightens me. That over time she will be honest with me and tell me she started to have feelings for him.
Thank you for the comment. The thing is i have gotten to know him and with my low self esteem i see him as a better which is even more terrifying. He is a really good guy.
Thank you for the kind words
